In a major initiative to expand global employment opportunities for youth, the Andhra Pradesh government has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Union Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) to establish a Skill India International Centre (SIIC) at NAC–Advanced Skill Training Institute (ASTI), Bommuru, Rajamahendravaram.
The MoU was signed in the presence of MSDE Secretary Debashree Mukherjee by MSDE Deputy Secretary Indu Bhusan Lenka and AP State Skill Development Corporation (APSSDC) Executive Director D. Manohar, representing their respective organisations.
In a statement on Friday (November 28, 2026), Mr. Manohar said the proposed centre will provide internationally aligned skills training, foreign-language instruction, cultural orientation, skill assessment and certification, visa and documentation assistance, pre-departure training and overseas placement support. It will focus on sectors such as healthcare, engineering, construction, logistics, hospitality and emerging green jobs by leveraging the state’s existing training institutions, he added.
The initiative will strengthen the ongoing Skill International Programme implemented by APSSDC and Overseas Manpower Company Andhra Pradesh (OMCAP), he said, adding that while APSSDC will facilitate candidate mobilisation, counselling and skill training, OMCAP will coordinate with overseas employers, facilitate recruitment, documentation and visa assistance, and support international placements.
The ED informed that since June 2024, the programme had trained 525 candidates, assessed 457 and certified 189, besides facilitating 1,993 overseas placements. Another 3,263 candidates were currently undergoing training, he said.
Through initiatives such as Project Vasudha, Project Sarvasethu and Project Blue Diamond, the state was creating overseas employment pathways in Germany, Japan, Russia, Italy and GCC countries, he said.
The establishment of SIIC is expected to strengthen Centre-State cooperation and position Andhra Pradesh as a major hub for globally skilled and certified manpower, ensuring safe, structured and legal overseas employment opportunities for its youth, he added.
